description.value: Tinhouse Brewing is a Port Coquitlam craft brewery and taproom that opened in 2019, with roots going back nearly a decade under the name Sapperton Brewing. The taproom features a 30-seat licensed outdoor patio and welcomes outside food, with local food trucks on weekends and nearby restaurant delivery options. A FAQ note points cyclists toward Dominion Park, just 600m along the trail, where open liquor is permitted and there is a playground.
